EXT.evidence: Provides brief, factual answers without initiating or elaborating beyond questions asked.

AGR.evidence: Responds straightforwardly about modeling and shares information about an available role without boasting or defensiveness.

CON.evidence: No behavior indicating organization, planning, or carelessness is shown.

NEU.evidence: No signs of nervousness, sensitivity, or marked confidence are evident in the short replies.

OPN.evidence: No expressions of curiosity, imagination, or resistance to new ideas appear in the dialogue.
